lines.en: Now, if you two were involved in a serious relationship,
that really creates a...
Ross, Your Honor, rest assured,
that relationship ended two years ago,
and can you please strike Consummated Like Bunnies
from the record?
Is there anything in this record that is actually true?
Uh, well, yes, we got married in Vegas,
and, uh, and the names, I think?
Well, based on what I've heard,
you two certainly don't qualify for an annulment.
If you don't want to be together,
you'll have to file for divorce.
That's great.
You happy now?
Look what you did with your funny, funny form.
What? Me?
What about you and your Consummated Like Bunnies nonsense?
And what are you typing that for?
See what he said?
We don't get the annulment.
Don't type that.
What?
Stop typing.
Hey, stop typing.
Stop typing, stop typing.
Okay, okay, do you see?
Do you see what you're keeping me married to?
You need to get out of my chambers.
All right, look, lady, here is the deal.
I came here for an annulment,
and I am not leaving here until I get one.
Would you like to spend the night in jail?
Thank you for your time.
